name: vikunja
title: Vikunja Task Manager
description: Create and manage tasks in your self-hosted Vikunja instance
author: flexorflex

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick Add
commands.subtitle: Vikunja
commands.description: Create a task from one line using Quick Add Magic (dates, *labels, +project, !priority, repeats)

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: Vikunja
commands.description: Create a new task in Vikunja

commands.name: list-tasks
commands.title: List Tasks
commands.subtitle: Vikunja
commands.description: Browse and manage tasks in your Vikunja projects

commands.name: list-projects
commands.title: List Projects
commands.subtitle: Vikunja
commands.description: Browse and manage your Vikunja projects

commands.name: search-tasks
commands.title: Search Tasks
commands.subtitle: Vikunja
commands.description: Search across all your Vikunja tasks

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: Vikunja URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Vikunja instance (e.g. https://tasks.example.com)

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Default project ID to show in List Tasks. Use "all" to show all projects.

preferences.name: quickAddMagicMode
preferences.title: Quick Add Magic
preferences.description: Which prefix syntax Quick Add uses to detect labels, projects and priorities.

preferences.name: defaultReminder
preferences.title: Default Reminder
preferences.description: Reminder to add automatically, relative to the task's due date. Tasks without a due date get no reminder.
